1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.G.A. for the State respondents.
2. Present writ petition is preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned FIR dated 05.12.2023,
registered as Case Crime No.702 of 2019, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 504, 506, 120-B I.P.C., P.S.- Rohaniya, District- Varanasi.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and falsely implicated with ulterior motive.
The dispute inter-se parties is civil in nature.
Learned counsel for the petitioner next submits that respondent No.3 has filed the protest petition against the petitioners only to harass them and to make pressure upon them.

Learned counsel for the petitioners further submits that petitioners never prepared any forged will-deed which was executed by the maternal uncle of the petitioner no.1 in his favour and the will-deed in question had not been declared forged.
The petitioner has no previous criminal antecedents.

In support of his submission, he has placed reliance on the judgement of Apex Court in Criminal Appeal No.932 of 2021 (Randheer Singh vs. the State of UP and ors) decided on 02.9.2021 as well as order dated 26.10.2021 passed in Criminal Appeal no.1285/2021 (Mitesh Kumar Jha vs. The State of Karnataka) and order dated 25.10.2021 passed in Criminal Appeal no.1393/2011 (Ramawatar vs. State of Madhya Pradesh) and submits that the Court must ensure that criminal prosecution is not used as an instrument of harassment or for fulfilling private vendetta or with an ulterior motive to pressurize the accused.
4.

sentences.text: Matter requires consideration by this Court.
5. Learned A.G.A. has accepted notice on behalf of State respondents.
6. Issue notice to the respondent No.3, returnable at an early date.
Steps be taken within a week.
7. Steps be taken within a week by ordinary process as well as by registered post.
8. All the respondents may file counter affidavit within four weeks.

Petitioner shall have one week,
thereafter, to file rejoinder affidavit.

9. Let the matter be listed after expiry of the aforesaid period.
10.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, as an interim measure, it is provided that till the next date of listing or till submission of police report u/s 173(2) Cr.P.C., whichever is earlier,
respondents are restrained to arrest the petitioners pursuant to the impugned FIR, subject to cooperation in the on-going investigation.
